full_page.content:
Page 110 Cont.
Nov. 9 Dr. Wm. Koch calls up - concerning a cancer patient - fearfully threating ten days ago. Dr. hardly able to speak from emotion. We asked for your prayers for the patient Pat McCarthy two weeks ago.
Ed' Angel -38- prayed for Oct 27 - 2 weeks ago - received everything before +
9 John J. Cronin - 3'2 -Acute appendicitis operation going on now - 9:40 p.m. - 10 appendix had
11 10:15 P.M. Sister and Mother phone from Toledo, 0. Commander H. Bartley's Great Lakes Hospital Chicago - very low .... 11/26/43 Sister here Today from Toledo. " ... still quite sick, but really pronounced out of danger.
Leland Lockridge - 19 - soldier - nervous break threatened.
14 Baby Roney Verble - 19 mo. - spinal maningitis - never baptized -
15 Dan Kissane - 36 - T.B. Battle Creek Hosp. Drs. want to remove 5 ribs - he hopes to put it off till after Xmas.
Page 111
Nov. 15 Mrs. Gabriella Smith - 33 - Episcopelian has husband and son - once Catholic.
Mrs. Cath. Pollard - 58 - inward goiter - blood transfusions.
Donald Nash - 3 - hit by car and badly crippled - one leg quite short and sight defective.
Nancy Wetherbee - 11 - serious condition of ears ...
Gary Hollihan - 5 - operated on day before yesterday, broken apend. - unconscious ever since.
See April 7th, '49 - Phil Drimen - 45 of Bay City - broken back - was paralysed - now using only one crutch.
19 Thanks - Mrs. Ida Hourigan - 61 - was to have operation - very threat- ening Sept .... no operations found necessary - is here in perfect health
